title: A General Framework for Relative Equilibria in the Symmetric Full Gravitational N-Body Problem
summary: We present a method to determine admissible configurations that lead to relative equilibria in the full gravitational N-body problem. The method exploits the SO(3) symmetry by working with its fundamental invariants and does not rely on restrictive assumptions about mass distributions or on truncating the gravitational potential. As a result, it yields necessary conditions that apply to arbitrary rigid-body configurations. This work is presented in two parts.
